note: The DATA frame END_STREAM flag is input-controlled and is passed to the request-body streaming callback.
For the reverse-proxy handler with has_body_stream, the first non-final DATA frame switches the request into streaming body mode.
On an END_STREAM DATA frame in streaming mode, the code clears the streaming completion callback without closing the receive state or installing a guard for later DATA frames.
Because the stream state remains H2O_HTTP2_STREAM_STATE_RECV_BODY after END_STREAM, an additional DATA frame is not rejected as closed.
The post-END_STREAM DATA frame reaches the streaming callback call site after write_req_chunk cleared the callback pointer, producing the target invalid call instead of a stream error.
